To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effectiveness of the public service delivery is a key element in the formation of digital society and the digital economy.
the effectiveness of public services is a key indicator of the development of digital economy.

there is a need of monitoring the accessibility and quality of public services, the development of the information society and the formation of the digital economy in Russia, which is based on modern methods of evaluation of effectiveness of public services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the effectiveness of the public services delivery in the digital economy, and the development of the information society.
the development of the concept of public services in digital economy.

the development of the methodology for assessing the effectiveness and ways of improving public services in the digital economy, which is based on a comprehensive approach and the use of a set of tools for assessing the quality, accessibility and efficiency of public services in the context of the development of digital economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

in the context of the development of digital economy, the effectiveness and quality of public services are determined by the level of development of the information society and the degree of readiness of the region for the development of the information technology.
it is necessary to develop a system for assessing the effectiveness of public services as part of digital economy development.
the digital economy and the development of public services in the digital format are closely related.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a need to create a unified approach to the formation of the digital economy and the delivery of public services.

the delivery of public services through the Internet is a new way of providing public services to citizens, and it is a way of improving the quality of public services, and it is also the way to improve the efficiency of public administration. In
the development of digital economy is impossible without digitalization of public services and without the creation of a favorable information environment in the country.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the development of digital economy in the Russian Federation requires the creation of a single information space, the improvement of information infrastructure and the development of information technologies.

there is no universal model of the digital economy, but the main components of the digital economy are the same for any country, and they are: information technology and communication, digital infrastructure, e government and digital services.

the development of the information society and the formation of the digital economy in Russia can be accelerated by improving the quality of public services, including the delivery of state and local government services in a digital environment.
